title: Selling Plans Fee Schedule — Subscription Rates and Billing Terms
content:
Northloop publishes this schedule of the subscription side of every **Selling Plans** tier: which billing terms each plan may be held on, what each term costs per month, how long an annual term runs and how it renews, and the day on which subscription fees are billed. All amounts are in USD.

## Schedule of subscription rates

| Plan | Billing terms offered | Monthly term fee (per month) | Annual term fee (per month) | Annual term length | Annual term renews automatically | Renewal reminder sent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | No subscription | USD 0.00 | Not offered | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Starter Store | Monthly or annual | USD 7.95 | USD 4.95 | 12 months | Yes | 30 calendar days before the term ends |
| Basic Store | Monthly or annual | USD 27.95 | USD 21.95 | 12 months | Yes | 30 calendar days before the term ends |
| Premium Store | Monthly or annual | USD 74.95 | USD 59.95 | 12 months | Yes | 30 calendar days before the term ends |
| Anchor Store | Monthly or annual | USD 349.95 | USD 299.95 | 12 months | Yes | 30 calendar days before the term ends |
| Enterprise Store | Annual only | Not offered | USD 2999.95 | 12 months | Yes | 60 calendar days before the term ends |

The annual term fee is billed monthly, and the seller is committed to it for the whole 12-month term.

## Billing day and first period

| Plan | Day of the month subscription fees are billed | First subscription period on activation |
|---|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Starter, Basic, Premium, Anchor and Enterprise Store | The same day of the month as the term start date; in a month that has no such day, the last day of that month | Billed in full |

## Notes on the schedule

- **No subscription on the Individual Seller Plan.** The Individual Seller Plan is held on no billing term and carries no subscription fee; its monthly figure of USD 0.00 records that nothing is billed.
- **Enterprise Store on the monthly term.** The monthly term is not offered on the Enterprise Store, so no monthly term fee exists for it.
- **Renewal reminder, worked on hypothetical dates.** A Premium Store annual term ending on 15 September has its renewal reminder sent by 16 August, 30 calendar days earlier; an Enterprise Store term ending on the same day has its reminder sent by 17 July, 60 calendar days earlier.
- **Billing day, worked on a hypothetical date.** A store whose term started on 31 January is billed on the 31st of each month that has one, and on 30 April in April.
